description: The standing of one ERC-8004 agent on BNB Smart Chain WATCHED for you: 4 dollars buys 7 days of standing_change messages for one agent id PUSHED to your https url, signed. The baseline standing arrives within five minutes, then one message each time the agent's evidence tier, its reachability (hireable, alive, gated, offline) or its registry feedback grade changes, each carrying the full unsigned standing (the same fields as agent_standing). For the buyer with money in escrow with an agent or an agent listed under its name. Call once per agent id; call again to renew or to watch another; manage with webhook_status and webhook_unregister. Method: standing_spec. Price: 4 dollars per call. A ChainHelix API key does not cover this tool.
